title: 1957 AHSME Problem 16
statement: Goldfish are sold at \(15\) cents each. The rectangular coordinate graph showing the cost of \(1\) to \(12\) goldfish is:

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text: a set of horizontal parallel line segments

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: a set of vertical parallel line segments

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: a finite set of distinct points

solutions.text:
The rule \(c=15n\) is linear, but the number \(n\) of goldfish can only be one of the twelve integers \(1,2,\ldots,12.\) The graph therefore consists of twelve distinct points, not an entire line or segment.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Decide whether the number of fish varies continuously or only through whole numbers
There is one cost point for each integer count from \(1\) through \(12\)
